issue_title: [Bug] _ensure_parent_directory TOCTOU race: parent check and mkdir not atomic

plan.summary: Fix TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by replacing check-then-act pattern with try/except using exist_ok=True

files_to_touch.description: New regression test file for TOCTOU race fix

tdd_sequence.description: Create failing regression test that demonstrates TOCTOU race condition

implementation.fix_description: Fixed TOCTOU race condition in _ensure_parent_directory by using mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) instead of check-then-act pattern. Added FileExistsError exception handling to catch cases where another process creates a file at the parent path.
